description: The single asset manifest for vite-three-canvas. The hero geometry is generated from a seed rather than fetched, so the only runtime assets are the two poster variants and the scene loads nothing over the network.

assets.purpose: Landscape poster fallback, captured from the hero-wide station of the live scene rather than drawn separately.
Portrait poster fallback, captured from the hero-portrait station, which is a different composition and not the landscape shot cropped.
